meta.name: dev-browser
meta.description: Browser automation with persistent page state. Use when users ask to navigate websites, fill forms, take screenshots, extract web data, test web apps, or automate browser workflows. Trigger phrases include "go to [url]", "click on", "fill out the form", "take a screenshot", "scrape", "automate", "test the website", "log into", or any browser interaction request.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操控浏览器完成网页交互与数据提取
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用代码控制浏览器执行重复操作
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser interactions and extract web data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to control a browser programmatically for repetitive tasks

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能帮你操作真实浏览器:打开网页、点击、填表、截图、抓取数据,还能在多次操作之间保持页面状态不变。
howto.when: 当你说“去某网址”“点一下”“截图”等,或要求填写表单、抓取数据、测试网页时触发。

say.note: 会启动浏览器访问该网址并保存截图

say.text: 帮我在这个页面填好登录表单
say.note: 会找到登录表单并填写

say.text: 抓取这个列表页的所有链接标题
say.note: 会提取页面上的链接标题并输出

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can control a real browser: open pages, click, fill forms, take screenshots, extract data, and keep page state between steps.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to visit a URL, click, fill a form, take a screenshot, scrape data, test a webpage, or log in, or say phrases like 'go to [url]' or 'take a screenshot'.

say_en.text: Open example.com and take a screenshot
say_en.note: Launches browser, visits site, saves screenshot

say_en.text: Fill in the login form on this page
say_en.note: Locates inputs via accessibility snapshot and fills them

say_en.text: Extract all link titles from this list page
say_en.note: Reads the page and outputs the titles
